resources.string: A safe-listening companion: it adapts your music volume to the noise around you and keeps track of the exposure dose your ears can take.
Your privacy: sound is analysed on your device and never recorded or uploaded. Only aggregated levels are stored.
WaveHeaven is not a medical device. If you notice ringing, muffled hearing or pain, see an audiologist.
Created by Jean Carlo Londoño and Alejandro Garcés, remastering WaveHeaven, a university project at EAFIT.
